basic_info.description: $200,000.00 price reduction! This expansive light-filled duplex situated in esteemed Russian Hill offers vast opportunities for entertainment and dining. The 3rd floor unit consists 2 bedrooms & sunroom, and 1 & a half baths. 2nd floor with same lovely floor plan. It is owner occupied. The home boasts class molding, High ceiling, fresh exterior paint and a beautifully updated eat-in kitchen,  formal dining room and living room with fireplace.  Two additional bonus in-law apt. located in the basement area. An extraordinary large backyard space with endless possibilities for a patio, lush landscaping and indoor & outdoor living. Minutes to famed Lombard Street, Washington Square Park, and countless highly-rated eateries. Conveniently close to the SF pier 39. Easy access to Highway 80 and 101. This is a great owner-occupier investment opportunity with lot of potential.
